sample_hash_method: Sorted unique expression strings serialized as compact UTF-8 JSON
syntax_hash_method: SHA256 of sorted relative UTF-8 path, NUL, file SHA256 ASCII hex, newline; source paths relative to src, syntax paths relative to repository

toolchain.scope: All src directories outside testdata, including cmd, vendor, tests and platform variants; no build-tag filtering

limitations: Focused lexical boundaries and underscore mutations, not exhaustive invalid-input coverage
Malformed numeric tokens are Illegal; exact Go erroneous-token recovery/messages are not compared
Numeric value legality and typing remain semantic work; parser acceptance follows go/parser
Exact Unicode identifier categories and per-file testdata classification remain incomplete
